patch.value: The current coverage gate enumerates all production TypeScript sources correctly but accepts aggregate thresholds of 81 lines, 74 branches, and 88 functions. The pm 2026.8.20 release run measured 86.93% lines, 80.26% branches, and 88.18% functions, so passing release:check is not proof of the required exact source coverage. Raise all dimensions to 100 and add behavior-driven unit, integration, functional, and installed-command tests for every real path without ignores, synthetic coverage calls, duplicated tests, or lowered scope.

coverageGate enumerates every executable production TypeScript source and enforces 100 lines, 100 branches, and 100 functions; Every new test asserts externally meaningful behavior or a named refusal and mutation tests prove critical guards are non-vacuous; No coverage ignore, c8 exclusion, unreachable pragma, threshold exception, or artificial invocation is used; The full release check reports exact 100/100/100 across the measured all-source set
